name: Pythia — Knowledge Synthesis Deep Learner
description: Absorbs all CSV registers (protocols, models, extensions, architectures, marketplace) into a TF-IDF knowledge index at boot. Zero external dependencies — the registers ARE the corpus. Semantic retrieval over 251 protocols + all other registers without any embedding API.
capabilities: absorb(register) — ingest any CSV register into the knowledge index
query(text, topK) — TF-IDF cosine similarity search across all absorbed registers
synthesize(text) — multi-register synthesis report for a query
getCorpusStats() — size and coverage of the knowledge index
